articles.summary: HONG KONG, March 25, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — J-Long Group Limited (“JL” or the“Company”) (NASDAQ: JL), JL conducts its primary operations of apparel trims solution services in Hong Kong, today announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended September 30, 2023.
